text: Two real commands. dbt docs generate compiles a catalog from the project's actual metadata. dbt docs serve starts a local server and opens that catalog as a browsable site.

Nothing about this chapter's descriptions or tests needs to be written twice. The docs reuse exactly what already exists in schema.yml, plus current pass and fail status pulled from the last dbt test run.

The lineage graph now shows this chapter's additions as real nodes and edges: raw_orders and raw_payments flowing into their staging models, both of those and the customers mart flowing into the intermediate join, and that flowing into fct_orders.

This is the clearest way to see Lesson 2's plan made real. If a model is missing an edge you expect, that's a ref or source call that isn't wired up the way you think it is — worth catching here, before Power BI gets involved.
Next lesson: connecting Power BI to the marts — the real Get Data flow into Snowflake, server, warehouse, and role.
